name: geojson-atlas
description: GeoJSON files: summary, RFC 7946 validation, properties. Pro: geometry quality review and lengths and areas. Works offline.

commands.title: GeoJSON Atlas: Remove Licence From This Machine

walkthroughs.title: Get started with GeoJSON Atlas
walkthroughs.description: Open a sample GeoJSON file, see its summary, validation and properties, and try the Pro geometry quality review and measurements in the free 14-day trial.

steps.title: Open a sample file
steps.description:
GeoJSON Atlas reads GeoJSON (RFC 7946): feature collections, single features and bare geometries in WGS 84 longitude and latitude. The sample is an invented city logistics file with a swapped point, a duplicate point and too precise coordinates, so every report has something to show.
[Open Sample File](command:geojsonAtlas.openSample)

steps.title: Run Show GeoJSON Summary
steps.description:
The file at a glance: features, ids, features without geometry, bounding box and geometry types. The report opens as a new Markdown document; your file is not changed.
[Show GeoJSON Summary](command:geojsonAtlas.showSummary)

steps.title: Use the other free reports
steps.description:
Every free report works without a key, an account or a network connection: Show Validation, Show Properties.
[Show Validation](command:geojsonAtlas.showValidation)
[Show Properties](command:geojsonAtlas.showProperties)

steps.title: Try Pro free for 14 days
steps.description:
The first Pro command you run starts a free 14-day trial on this computer, with no key and no network: Show Geometry Quality, Show Measurements.
[Show Geometry Quality](command:geojsonAtlas.showQuality)

steps.title: Licence and help
steps.description:
Buy Pro (Personal USD 19, Business USD 39 per user), enter a key, see the licence status, or report a problem.
[Show Licence Status](command:geojsonAtlas.licenceStatus)
[Report A Problem](command:geojsonAtlas.reportProblem)

geojsonAtlas.maxFileSizeMB.markdownDescription: Largest file (in MB) a report reads, up to 50 MB (VS Code passes files only up to 50 MB to extensions). Larger files are refused with a message.

geojsonAtlas.openReportsAsPreview.markdownDescription: Open each report in the Markdown preview as well as in a new editor.
